queries.text: Single-link conditional law in SU(2) (two-colour) lattice gauge theory: given all other links, the link is von Mises-Fisher distributed on the three-sphere S^3 with mean direction the staple sum (sum over plaquettes containing the link of the ordered product of the other three links); how a large plaquette deviation becomes an exponentially small spherical-cap probability whose rate is set by the angle between the staple direction and the cap centre

Cavity / heat-bath conditional measure of one two-colour link: a concentrated Fisher-type directional distribution on the three-sphere with mean direction given by the staple, and the resulting rare-source (Lemma Q style) tail bound: an exponentially small cap probability whose exponent depends on the alignment of the mean direction with the cap centre

Why conditioning on every other link makes a single two-colour link variable a concentrated directional law on the 3-sphere centred on the sum of ordered three-link products over the adjacent plaquettes, and how this yields a single-plaquette large-deviation estimate as an exponentially small cap probability with an alignment-dependent rate

Conditional single-link tail estimate: the link's Gibbs law given the rest is a von Mises-Fisher law on S^3 whose mean is the sum over plaquettes containing it of the ordered product of each plaquette's remaining three links; a large plaquette-deviation event is bounded by an exponentially small spherical cap probability with rate depending on the angle between the mean direction and the cap centre
